name: Velarina No. 01 Structured Tote
shortDescription: Full-grain Tuscan calfskin tote with reinforced handles and solid brass hardware.
description: The No. 01 Structured Tote is crafted from 2.2 mm vegetable-tanned calfskin sourced from an artisanal tannery outside Florence. The interior features an unlined suede finish with a single zippered slip pocket. Edges are hand-bevelled and burnished with natural beeswax.

details.dimensions: 38 cm H x 32 cm W x 14 cm D
details.materials: 100% full-grain vegetable-tanned calfskin, solid brass hardware
details.care: Treat twice annually with natural leather balm. Store in the supplied cotton dust cover away from direct sunlight.

name: Velarina Studio Weekender Duffel
shortDescription: Heavy 22oz waxed cotton canvas bag with bridle leather straps and brass two-way zipper.
description: Constructed from Scottish 22oz weatherproof waxed canvas and finished with 3.5 mm saddle-stitched bridle leather harness straps. Sized to meet international cabin baggage regulations for weekend transit.

details.dimensions: 52 cm L x 28 cm W x 30 cm H
details.materials: Scottish waxed cotton canvas, English bridle leather, solid brass YKK Excella zippers
details.care: Spot clean with cold water and a soft brush. Do not machine wash or dry clean.

name: Velarina Atelier Double-Breasted Trench
shortDescription: Japanese compact cotton gabardine coat with horn buttons and storm flap.
description: A tailored double-breasted coat woven from 100% long-staple Japanese cotton gabardine with water-repellent finishing. Designed with raglan sleeves, a structured belt with brass D-rings, and genuine buffalo horn buttons.

details.sizing: True to size. Regular tailored cut.
details.materials: Shell: 100% Japanese cotton gabardine. Lining: 100% cupro. Buttons: genuine buffalo horn.
details.care: Specialist dry clean only. Cool iron under pressing cloth.

name: Velarina Relaxed Wool Pleated Trouser
shortDescription: Virgin wool flannel trouser with twin forward pleats and extended tab closure.
description: Cut with a mid-high rise and gentle taper, these trousers are woven in Biella, Italy from 310 gsm virgin wool flannel. Features deep front pleats, side adjusters, and unhemmed cuffs for bespoke alterations.

details.materials: 100% virgin wool flannel from Biella, Italy. Interior waistband: 100% cotton canvas.
details.care: Dry clean only. Hang on cedar trouser bar between wears.

name: Velarina Minimalist Card Folio
shortDescription: French box calf leather card sleeve with four slots and central folded currency pocket.
description: Measuring only 4 mm in thickness, the Card Folio accommodates four payment cards and folded bank notes. The leather is drum-dyed French box calf with hand-creased perimeter borders and edge-paint applied in four coats.

details.materials: French box calf leather, waxed polyester thread
details.care: Wipe with clean dry microfiber cloth. Avoid prolonged contact with water.

name: Velarina Heavy Cashmere Scarf
shortDescription: Grade-A Mongolian cashmere scarf with fringed ends and dense twill weave.
description: Woven on traditional looms from 100% pure Grade-A Mongolian cashmere fiber. Teaseled with natural dried teasels to achieve a subtle ripple surface that traps warmth without excess bulk.

details.dimensions: 180 cm L x 45 cm W (excluding fringe)
details.care: Hand wash gently in lukewarm water with mild wool detergent. Lay flat on towel to dry.

name: Velarina Sand-Cast Bronze Catchall
shortDescription: Solid sand-cast bronze dish with hand-brushed finish and cork base pad.
description: Cast in a small foundry using traditional sand molds, each catchall displays subtle organic surface textures unique to the casting batch. The bronze is left unlacquered to develop a rich natural patina over years of use.

details.materials: Solid sand-cast bronze, natural cork protective base
details.care: Allow natural patina to develop, or polish with bronze cream to restore original golden luster.

name: Velarina Stoneware Oil Burner
shortDescription: Wheel-thrown volcanic clay oil burner with brass water well.
description: Hand-thrown using coarse iron-rich stoneware clay and fired in an oxidation kiln. Includes an independently spun brass dish for essential oils and water, designed to sit over a standard tealight candle.

details.materials: Coarse volcanic stoneware clay, solid spun brass dish
details.care: Hand wash with mild detergent. Brass dish can be cleaned with lemon juice and salt.
